limitations: No chest spawn in the checked data is confirmed by Forever-specific position observations.
Classic-derived sites are not independent confirmation when they share CMaNGOS data.
Coverage is the obtained reference set, not a claim of every live Forever spawn.
Three additional snapshot locations are absent from other coordinate sets; they fall inside current Desolace terrain bounds and outside Shendralas terrain bounds.
Moving NPCs and rare reference points do not describe complete patrol routes.
Variant letters C/H are guide labels; keep object IDs as actual identity.
Quest-object chests are not random treasure-chest spawn points.
Research collection did not modify existing quest/drop records or completion storage.
